memories.content:
ENHANCED TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM COMPLETED for The Dutch Queen website. Created comprehensive royal theatrical typography system with:

FONTS: Cinzel (display-primary), Playfair Display (display-secondary), Oswald (nav-primary), Source Sans Pro (body-primary), Inter (body-accent)

CSS CLASSES: .text-display-xl, .text-section-title, .text-nav-primary, .text-content-primary, .text-button-primary, .text-performance-title, .text-performance-detail

THEATRICAL EFFECTS: .text-gradient-royal, .text-gradient-metallic, .text-gradient-dramatic with animated gradients

RESPONSIVE: Fluid scaling with clamp() functions, mobile-first approach 48px→128px for display-xl

PERFORMANCE: ~180KB total, optimized Google Fonts loading with display=swap, WCAG AA compliant

IMPLEMENTATION: Updated globals.css, tailwind.config.js, created TypographySystem.tsx showcase, updated about.tsx and navigation.tsx components, comprehensive README.md guide

USAGE: Use semantic classes like .text-section-title instead of inline font-family styles. System provides complete typography hierarchy for royal Queen tribute band branding.
